WITH site_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        s.zoneregistry,
        s.insurstat,
        AVG(m.facetresmm / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
        COUNT(m.facetregistry) AS mesh_record_count
    FROM sites AS s
    JOIN scanmesh AS m
      ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
    GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat
), status_averages AS (
    SELECT insurstat, AVG(avg_ratio) AS status_avg_ratio
    FROM site_metrics
    WHERE insurstat IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY insurstat
), kept_sites AS (
    SELECT sm.insurstat, sm.avg_ratio, sa.status_avg_ratio
    FROM site_metrics AS sm
    JOIN status_averages AS sa
      ON sa.insurstat = sm.insurstat
    WHERE sm.avg_ratio > sa.status_avg_ratio
)
SELECT
    insurstat,
    AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_kept_site_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS kept_site_count,
    AVG(avg_ratio - status_avg_ratio) AS avg_excess_over_status_avg
FROM kept_sites
GROUP BY insurstat
